OWNER DECISION — START FULL RORK INDEPENDENCE AUDIT

Choose:

1a — READ-ONLY AUDIT FIRST
2b — INCLUDE A REAL REPLACEMENT PLAN FOR THE AI GATEWAY AND BUILD PIPELINE

Do not modify production yet.

First complete a full read-only map of every active Rork dependency.

Audit:

1. Source-code references
2. Packages and SDKs
3. Environment variables
4. API base URLs
5. AI gateway or proxy
6. Chat gateway
7. Build pipeline
8. CI/CD
9. Render services
10. GitHub integrations
11. Expo/EAS configuration
12. Android configuration
13. iOS configuration
14. Supabase configuration
15. Webhooks
16. Analytics and telemetry
17. Runtime network requests
18. Authentication dependencies
19. Deployment dependencies
20. Update and rollback dependencies

For every finding return:

- Exact file
- Exact line
- Service or component
- Dependency purpose
- Active / inactive / legacy / documentation
- Rork-owned: YES / NO / UNKNOWN
- Production-critical: YES / NO
- Replacement required: YES / NO
- Recommended IVX-controlled replacement
- Risk of removal
- Verification method

Do not remove or change anything during this first phase.

Important:

- A repository name containing “rork” is not automatically an active dependency.
- Rork-generated code can remain if IVX owns it and it does not call Rork services.
- The target is zero active Rork runtime, API, SDK, proxy, telemetry, authentication, deployment, and build dependency.
- Do not classify any item as removed until verified in source, build, runtime, and production network traffic.

For items you cannot verify because tool access is unavailable, mark:

UNKNOWN — EXTERNAL ACCESS REQUIRED

Do not invent PASS.

After the read-only audit, produce:

A. ACTIVE RORK DEPENDENCIES
B. LEGACY RORK REFERENCES
C. FALSE POSITIVES
D. UNKNOWN ITEMS
E. REPLACEMENT ROADMAP
F. SAFE MIGRATION ORDER
G. ROLLBACK PLAN

The replacement roadmap must include the current Rork AI gateway/build pipeline.

For that component, identify:

- Current source files
- Current provider
- Current base URL
- Current credential names
- Current Render service
- Current build dependency
- Current deployment dependency
- Current fallback behavior
- Direct IVX-controlled replacement architecture
- Migration steps
- Test plan
- Rollback plan
- Estimated production risk

Do not stop to ask more scoping questions.

Proceed with:

READ-ONLY AUDIT
→ COMPLETE MAP
→ REPLACEMENT PLAN
→ REPORT FINDINGS

Do not perform removal until I approve Phase 2.
